scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/types && concurrently "npm run start:dev -w packages/api" "npm run dev -w packages/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w packages/api && npm run build -w packages/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run test --workspaces --if-present -- --passWithNoTests
